author: Matt Wolfe
description:
People are calling this the "SaaSpocalypse" 🚨

Anthropic dropped a few new AI updates recently, one of them being Claude Cowork plugins that integrates specialized tools for sales, legal, finance, marketing and more directly into Claude.

And apparently, this has put the entire SaaS business model on notice.

The market’s reaction was swift... but is it an overreaction or the end of a SaaS-dominated era? 

#AI #Anthropic #Claude #Stockmarket #AInews
title: This AI Update Wiped Out $400 Billion In Tech Stocks
